claim_ceiling: Authored threat/fault scenarios for design qualification only. Not observed incident rates, probabilities, attack instructions, security certification, site survey or operational test evidence.

semantics.severity: qualitative design priority; not a calibrated risk score
semantics.acceptance: evidence required before a scenario can be marked passed

global_invariants: A remote analytics or reserve-compute fault must not become a safety-critical vessel, port, grid or industrial control authority.
No single production credential or production control plane may destroy every recovery copy.
Unknown integrity, rights, power, cooling or communications state must fail closed for new mutations and preserve local safe/degraded operation.
A subsea pod must not be credited as recovered until service, data integrity and evidence are independently verified.
An active hydrothermal vent field is an exclusion for industrial siting and vent-energy extraction in this programme.

scenarios.title: Production administrator compromise attempts backup deletion
scenarios.trigger: Adversary obtains a production privileged identity and issues destructive backup operations.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Reject destructive mutation of protected recovery copies; alert through an independent channel; preserve known-good baseline.
acceptance_tests: Use production credentials against every backup deletion and retention path; all protected copies remain intact.
Verify that backup restore does not require the compromised production identity.

scenarios.title: Malicious or invalid signed firmware/software update
scenarios.trigger: Update provenance, signature, build identity or expected measurement does not match the approved release.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Do not install or activate the update; preserve previous approved image; quarantine the artifact and retain evidence.
acceptance_tests: Reject altered, unsigned, revoked and wrong-target artifacts.
Demonstrate recovery after power interruption during a staged update.

scenarios.title: Single subsea export-fibre route is severed
scenarios.trigger: Physical interruption or optical failure on one export route.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Continue only pre-authorized local workloads; buffer data with integrity metadata; no unsafe dependency on remote services.
acceptance_tests: Blindly remove each declared route in turn.
Prove that the surviving route does not share a single duct, beach manhole, landing station, provider or terrestrial bottleneck with the failed route.

scenarios.title: Both nominally redundant fibre paths share a hidden common cause
scenarios.trigger: Two circuits share a landing station, cable corridor, terrestrial duct, upstream carrier or common management/control plane.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Do not award redundancy credit; treat both paths as one failure domain until independence is proved.
acceptance_tests: Run common-cause cut-set analysis over the complete route and provider graph.
Remove each shared node and recalculate reachability.

scenarios.title: Unauthorized or anomalous subsea intervention is detected
scenarios.trigger: A site monitor or trusted third-party report indicates unexpected contact, manipulation or approach near a pod or cable route.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Isolate affected interfaces where safe; preserve logs and service state; do not assume an alert proves attribution or compromise.
acceptance_tests: Exercise non-destructive tamper indicators and alarm-path failures.
Verify that loss of management connectivity does not cause unsafe automatic actuation.

scenarios.title: Depth-rated inspection/intervention capability reaches the deployment depth
scenarios.trigger: Threat model includes professional ROV/submersible access rather than assuming depth prevents access.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Security claim remains limited to measured deterrence/detection/delay; availability and recovery must survive loss of one pod.
acceptance_tests: Red-team the stated threat model with authorized independent reviewers.
Demonstrate that a single pod loss cannot destroy all data or service capacity.

scenarios.title: Shore export power fails while subsea pod is isolated from remote services
scenarios.trigger: Loss of normal grid or export cable supply.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Preserve data integrity, controlled shutdown or explicitly bounded local service; no unqualified restart.
acceptance_tests: Test loss of each incoming source and verify load-shed ordering.
Measure critical-load autonomy with actual power and cooling telemetry.
Test black-start and restart under worst-case declared load.

scenarios.title: Heat exchanger fouling, pump trip or seawater temperature excursion
scenarios.trigger: A cooling-train fault or environmental condition reduces heat-rejection capacity.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Reduce or stop workload before thermal limits are exceeded; protect equipment and marine environment; do not continue on unverified thermal state.
acceptance_tests: Inject pump trip and rising source temperature.
Measure pump, cooling and auxiliary energy under fouled and clean conditions.
Verify no unapproved outfall condition.

scenarios.title: Seabed instability, seismic event or sediment turbidity current
scenarios.trigger: Site-specific hazard limit is exceeded or monitoring becomes unavailable during a geohazard.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Enter prequalified safe state; do not rely on continuing a forecast or model when measurements are stale or contradictory.
acceptance_tests: Replay surveyed hazard envelopes and monitoring dropout.
Show that the site exclusion criteria and shutdown thresholds are explicit and independently reviewed.

scenarios.title: Candidate site intersects active hydrothermal vent habitat or a protected exclusion
scenarios.trigger: Survey, regulator or authoritative habitat dataset identifies active venting, sensitive benthic habitat or a legally/operationally excluded area.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Reject industrial siting and vent-energy extraction at that site; retain only approved non-invasive science activity.
acceptance_tests: Inject a positive vent/protected-area finding into the site screen; candidate is blocked regardless of energy or cost score.
Verify exclusion data provenance and version.
evidence_required: official spatial layer and legal review

scenarios.title: Pod cannot be serviced or retrieved within its declared window
scenarios.trigger: Weather, vessel availability, port access, spare-part failure or lifting-system fault delays maintenance.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Do not claim availability beyond the proven service interval; shift workloads to the independent site and preserve the pod's safe state.
acceptance_tests: Blindly remove the primary recovery vessel and one critical spare from the scenario.
Calculate service-level degradation through the full weather and retrieval window.

scenarios.title: Sensor quality, calibration or time synchronisation becomes unknown
scenarios.trigger: Thermal, power, flow, pressure, intrusion or environmental measurement is stale, out of calibration, contradictory or unauthenticated.
scenarios.expected_disposition: Mark affected evidence unknown; suspend decisions that require it; preserve local safe operation and collect a reconciliation record.
acceptance_tests: Inject clock skew, stale values, sensor substitution, calibration expiry and contradictory channels.
Verify that unknown telemetry cannot authorize a new energy, thermal or security state transition.
